hazards.control: Hands clear of slips, tongs, and the drawworks; guards on rotating parts.

name: Drawworks and brake
function: The winch that spools the drilling line to raise and lower the block, with the brake that holds the string.

tabs.overview: Engine or electric drive; band or disc brake; the driller controls it from the doghouse or floor console.
tabs.engineering: Line pull and brake capacity for the string weight.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 16A (S48), API Std 53 (S49), API RP 16ST (S53), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
